label: a piano keyboard.
why: The clip has a hard cut near 3.5 s and a dissolve from about 5.75 s to 6.75 s into a close view of a long row of piano keys in a factory; from 7.0 s to 9.0 s the keyboard fills the frame and the camera slides and tilts along it. This is the only stretch after the dissolve where the keyboard is clear and uninterrupted, though only the camera moves.
